_meta.title: Vanigam funding catalogue
_meta.purpose: Curated list of funding routes for Tamil Nadu founders across five channels. Research data, not yet encoded as engine rules: eligibility here is summarised text, and every entry must be confirmed on its official source before it becomes a rule in schemes/seed.py.

channels.bank: Loans: bank and state-finance products, including scheme-linked loans
channels.investor: Equity investors, angel networks and government-backed funds
channels.demand: Funding that follows a buyer's need: challenges, problem statements, procurement, cluster programmes

status_values.cohort: Runs in periodic cohorts or calls; check the current call
status_values.between_calls: Recurring, but the latest window has closed
status_values.closed: Ended or applications closed, no successor notified
status_values.revamping: Ended; a redesigned version has been announced
status_values.lapsed_pending: End date passed; renewal proposed but not confirmed
status_values.not_in_tn: Active nationally but not implemented in Tamil Nadu
status_values.unverified: Exists, but current status could not be confirmed

confidence_values.official: Confirmed on the scheme's official page
confidence_values.secondary: From press or third-party summaries; confirm on the official page

schemes.name: TANSEED (Tamil Nadu Startup Seed Grant Fund)
schemes.benefit: Support-equity-linked grant: ₹10L; ₹15L for women-led, green-tech and rural-impact startups. StartupTN takes a 3% support stake. Includes a one-year accelerator.
eligibility: Private Limited company or LLP registered in Tamil Nadu
DPIIT recognised and registered with StartupTN
Prototype or MVP showing technology-led innovation
At least 51% Indian promoter ownership; not a subsidiary or spin-off
Selected competitively: bootcamp, then jury pitch
schemes.status_note: TANSEED 8.0 closed 30 Jan 2026; next edition not yet announced.

schemes.name: NEEDS (New Entrepreneur-cum-Enterprise Development Scheme)
schemes.benefit: 25% capital subsidy on project cost (max ₹75L) + 3% interest subvention for the full repayment period.
eligibility: Age 21–45; up to 55 for women, BC/MBC/SC/ST, ex-servicemen, transgender, differently abled
Education: HSC, ITI, diploma, degree or vocational training
Tamil Nadu resident for at least 3 years
schemes.status_note: Applications online through the MSME portal.

schemes.name: UYEGP (Unemployed Youth Employment Generation Programme)
schemes.agency: MSME Department, Tamil Nadu (via District Industries Centres)
schemes.benefit: 25% subsidy on project cost; sources disagree on the cap (₹1.25L vs ₹2.5L), so confirm on the official page. Loans up to ₹15L. Subsidy held as a 3-year term deposit, then adjusted against the loan.
schemes.status_note: Applications through msmeonline.tn.gov.in.

schemes.name: Annal Ambedkar Business Champions Scheme (AABCS)
schemes.benefit: 35% capital subsidy (project cost up to ₹1.5Cr, so up to ₹52.5L) + 6% interest subvention.
eligibility: New or expanding manufacturing, service or eligible trading units
schemes.status_note: Applications online through the MSME portal.

schemes.name: Kalaignar Kaivinai Thittam (KKT)
schemes.benefit: Credit up to ₹3L, 25% subsidy (cap ₹50,000), 5% interest subvention, training and marketing support. No collateral.
eligibility: At least 5 years' experience in one of 25 listed trades
Not limited to family trade or caste
schemes.status_note: Tamil Nadu's alternative to PM Vishwakarma.

schemes.name: Tamil Nadu SC/ST Startup Fund
schemes.benefit: Equity or debt investment, up to ₹5Cr per startup.
eligibility: More than 50% equity held by SC/ST founders
Native of Tamil Nadu or of Tamil origin; preference for operations in Tamil Nadu
DPIIT recognised and registered with StartupTN
schemes.status_note: ₹50Cr fund (Budget 2023-24); invests in batches.

schemes.name: Gramam Thorum Puthozhil (Startups in Villages)
schemes.benefit: ₹1L equity-free grant for one venture per village; top teams can reach TANSEED funding up to ₹10L.
eligibility: Venture from one of the 100 participating villages
schemes.status_note: Launched 2025; hubs signing MoUs with colleges.

schemes.name: TN Startup Policy reimbursements (patents, quality certification, marketing)
schemes.benefit: Reimbursement of Indian and international patent filing, mandatory quality certification and marketing/exhibition costs, within policy caps.
schemes.status_note: Caps depend on the current policy edition; confirm amounts.

schemes.name: Tamil Nadu Deep Tech Startup Policy 2025–26 grants
schemes.benefit: Technology-readiness-linked R&D grants (up to TRL 4), commercialisation and scale-up support; ₹100Cr mobilisation for 100 startups.
eligibility: Deep tech startup in a priority sector (electronics and semiconductors, EV, health and biotech, clean energy, aerospace, enterprise tech)
Funding tied to technology readiness level
schemes.status_note: Policy launched 2025–26; grant calls and amounts to be confirmed.

schemes.name: TABCEDCO business loans
schemes.agency: Tamil Nadu Backward Classes Economic Development Corporation
schemes.benefit: Low-interest loans for viable trades, businesses and projects, for individuals and groups.
eligibility: Belongs to BC, MBC or Denotified Communities
schemes.status_note: District notices published in 2026.

schemes.name: TAMCO loans for minorities
schemes.agency: Tamil Nadu Minorities Economic Development Corporation
schemes.benefit: Low-interest individual and SHG micro-enterprise loans; Viraasat loans for artisans.
eligibility: Belongs to a notified minority community
schemes.status_note: District notices published in 2026.

schemes.name: TIIC Proto Loan Scheme
schemes.benefit: Loan for startups from idea to prototype.
eligibility: Established no more than 2 years ago
schemes.status_note: TIIC prime lending rate cut to 9.95% from 1 July 2026; fees waived on FY 2026-27 term loans.

schemes.name: TIIC Propel Loan Scheme
schemes.benefit: Loan for early-stage startups' funding needs; follows Proto.
eligibility: No earlier assistance for the same project (except TIIC Proto)

schemes.name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
schemes.benefit: Up to ₹20L grant and ₹50L debt through incubators.
schemes.status_note: Applications closed 31 May 2026; no successor cycle notified.

schemes.name: PMEGP (Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme)
schemes.agency: KVIC / Ministry of MSME (loans via banks)
schemes.benefit: Margin-money subsidy 15–35%: general 15% urban / 25% rural; special categories 25% urban / 35% rural. Project cost up to ₹50L manufacturing, ₹20L service.
eligibility: Typically cannot combine with another government capital subsidy for the same project
schemes.status_note: Applications on the PMEGP portal; loans through banks.

schemes.name: PMFME (micro food processing enterprises)
schemes.benefit: 35% credit-linked capital subsidy, max ₹10L per unit.
eligibility: Micro food processing unit, SHG, FPO or cooperative
schemes.status_note: Extended to 30 Sep 2026; a 5-year continuation is proposed but not yet confirmed.

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma
schemes.benefit: ₹3L collateral-free loan at 5% in two tranches, ₹15,000 toolkit, paid training.
eligibility: Self-employed in one of 18 traditional trades
schemes.status_note: Tamil Nadu chose not to implement it; Kalaignar Kaivinai Thittam is the state alternative.

schemes.name: Stand-Up India
schemes.benefit: ₹10L–₹1Cr composite loan for greenfield enterprises.
schemes.status_note: Ended March 2025; a revamped scheme with higher limits was announced in 2026.

schemes.name: Term loans for first-time women, SC and ST entrepreneurs (Budget 2025)
schemes.benefit: Term loans up to ₹2Cr for 5 lakh first-time entrepreneurs over five years, with capacity building.
schemes.status_note: Announced in Budget 2025-26; operational guidelines not confirmed.

schemes.name: PM MUDRA Yojana (Shishu, Kishore, Tarun, Tarun Plus)
schemes.agency: MUDRA / SIDBI (via all banks, NBFCs, MFIs)
schemes.benefit: Collateral-free loans: Shishu ≤ ₹50k, Kishore ≤ ₹5L, Tarun ≤ ₹10L, Tarun Plus ₹10–20L (only after repaying a Tarun loan).
eligibility: Tarun Plus: earlier Tarun loan repaid
schemes.status_note: Tarun Plus effective October 2024.

schemes.name: CGTMSE (credit guarantee for micro and small enterprises)
schemes.benefit: Guarantee cover so banks lend without collateral.
eligibility: Micro or small enterprise with Udyam registration
Loan from a member lending institution

schemes.name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups (CGSS)
schemes.benefit: Collateral-free credit guarantee up to ₹20Cr per startup: 85% cover up to ₹10Cr, 75% above.
eligibility: Loan, working capital or venture debt from an eligible lender
schemes.status_note: Limit raised to ₹20Cr from 8 May 2025.

schemes.name: SBI MSME UDAAN (finance to startups)
schemes.benefit: Startup loans up to ₹50Cr.

schemes.name: Canara Start-Up loan
schemes.benefit: Loans above ₹10L up to ₹20Cr.

schemes.name: Indian Bank IND Start Up Scheme
schemes.benefit: Loans up to ₹20Cr for DPIIT-recognised startups.
schemes.status_note: Indian Bank also runs IND Spring Board with IIT Madras Incubation Cell (status to confirm).

schemes.name: BIRAC Biotechnology Ignition Grant (BIG)
schemes.benefit: Up to ₹50L over 18 months to reach proof of concept.
eligibility: Indian company (51% Indian holding) under ~5 years old, or individual through a BIG partner
Biotech or life-sciences idea at proof-of-concept stage
schemes.status_note: Calls open around 1 January and 1 July, ~45 days each.

schemes.name: NIDHI PRAYAS (prototype grant)
schemes.agency: Department of Science & Technology (via PRAYAS centres)
schemes.benefit: Up to ₹10L to build a prototype, with lab access and mentoring.
eligibility: Innovator with a science or technology idea
schemes.status_note: Last deadline 19 June 2026; annual cycle.

schemes.name: MeitY SAMRIDH
schemes.benefit: Acceleration with matched funding, mentoring and market access for product startups.
eligibility: Tech product startup ready to scale
schemes.status_note: Rolling cohorts through accelerators.

schemes.name: MeitY GENESIS Investment 2.0
schemes.benefit: 1:1 matching equity up to ₹50L for Tier-2/3 tech startups raising a round.
eligibility: Tech startup in a Tier-2 or Tier-3 city
Not previously supported by TIDE 2.0 scale-up or SAMRIDH
schemes.status_note: Applications closed 24 Sep 2026.

schemes.name: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC) / ASIIM
schemes.agency: IFCI Venture Capital / Ministry of Social Justice
schemes.benefit: Concessional finance for SC-led companies; ASIIM gives SC students up to ₹30L over 3 years through incubators.
eligibility: ASIIM: SC student through a TBI
schemes.status_note: Online applications closed from 1 Aug 2026.

schemes.name: Fund of Funds for Startups (FFS, incl. 2.0)
schemes.benefit: Government capital in SEBI-registered VC funds (AIFs) that invest in startups; FFS 2.0 adds ₹10,000Cr with a deep-tech focus.
eligibility: Startup raises from an AIF backed by FFS; no direct application
schemes.status_note: 153 AIFs committed as of Dec 2025.

schemes.name: Tamil Nadu Emerging Sector Seed Fund (TNESSF)
schemes.benefit: Equity or convertibles: up to ₹1Cr early stage; ₹3–10Cr per round for mature companies.
eligibility: Company or LLP headquartered in Tamil Nadu (or willing to relocate)
Under 10 years old, turnover up to ₹25Cr
schemes.status_note: ₹100Cr anchor; sector agnostic.

schemes.name: TANFUND (StartupTN fund aggregator)
schemes.benefit: Connects startups to 300+ investors; ₹127Cr facilitated.
eligibility: Tamil Nadu startup with a funding requirement

schemes.name: AngelsTN (Global Tamil angels)
schemes.benefit: Diaspora Tamil angel investors and mentors matched by sector.

schemes.name: The Chennai Angels
schemes.benefit: Angel investment from a network of 120+ investors; co-invests with Native Angels.
eligibility: Scalable business with early traction or revenue

schemes.name: Native Angels Network
schemes.benefit: Regional angel network across Tamil Nadu.

schemes.name: Speciale Invest
schemes.benefit: Seed-stage VC for deep tech, aerospace and AI.

schemes.name: Startup India Investor Connect
schemes.benefit: National matchmaking with 5,000+ investors.

schemes.name: iDEX SPARK grants (Defence India Startup Challenge / Open Challenge)
schemes.benefit: Grant up to ₹1.5Cr to build a prototype for a stated defence need; route to procurement.
eligibility: Solution to a published problem statement
schemes.status_note: DISC 14 published 82 problem statements; latest Open Challenge closed 30 Sep 2026.

schemes.name: iDEX ADITI (deep-tech defence)
schemes.benefit: Up to ₹25Cr per project for critical defence technologies.
eligibility: Deep-tech project in one of 30 strategic technology areas
schemes.status_note: Runs in numbered editions (ADITI 4.0 listed).

schemes.name: Tamil Nadu Innovation Initiatives (TANII)
schemes.benefit: ₹100–150Cr a year for innovation projects in government departments; startups take part as solution partners to a department.
eligibility: Proposal sponsored by a government department or District Collector
schemes.status_note: Two appraisal rounds a year (Apr–Jun, Oct–Dec).

schemes.name: GeM Startup Runway (government procurement)
schemes.benefit: Sell to government buyers without prior-turnover, prior-experience or EMD requirements (when buyers enable them).
eligibility: Product or service listed on GeM

schemes.name: Atal New India Challenge (ANIC)
schemes.benefit: Up to ₹1Cr over 12–18 months for sector challenges, prototype to commercialisation.
eligibility: Startup or MSME solving a listed sector challenge
schemes.status_note: Last confirmed edition ANIC 2.0 (2022); check for a current round.

schemes.name: SFURTI (traditional industry clusters)
schemes.benefit: Common facilities, skills and marketing for traditional-industry clusters; 513 clusters approved.
eligibility: Group of artisans or units applying through an implementing agency

schemes.name: MSE Cluster Development Programme (MSE-CDP)
schemes.benefit: Common facility centres and infrastructure for MSE clusters; 242 projects in progress.
eligibility: Cluster of micro and small enterprises via a special purpose vehicle

schemes.name: STPI Chennai Open Challenge Program 3.0 (Industry 4.0 CoE)
schemes.benefit: Industry 4.0 problem statements from industry with support to build solutions.
schemes.status_note: Programme page found; current round not confirmed.
